brief.summary_1line: Sage Bharadwaja miraculously conjures a vast celestial feast and palace complex to host Bharata and his entire army overnight.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sage Bharadwaja sits in meditation in the sacrificial pavilion as gods, nymphs, and flower‑raining clouds appear around him.
Bharata’s astonished army enters a magically manifested city of white palaces, green lawns, and flowing streams created by the sage.
Thousands of soldiers feast, drink, and dance with celestial nymphs beneath trees dripping honey and lakes filled with wine.
